purpose: Evaluate one bounded scenario-native expert repair on already revealed E713-E715 before consuming untouched V89 confirmation seeds.

mechanism.family: scenario-native expert initializer plus atomic paper-welfare Pareto guard
mechanism.E3_definition: Use OCS-P's parents-scheduled frontier, native request order, current-demand score, 64-placement affinity history, and same-window projection for every function. Accept a coordinated Nash proposal only when immutable-baseline paper welfare strictly improves and the complete-assignment OCS sequential score is nonworse; otherwise dispatch the exact initializer.
mechanism.E4_definition: Use Jiagu-P's all-unscheduled frontier, 20-window mean-plus-trend demand forecast, forecast-descending player order, demand-sized candidate prefix, and projected-load choice. Accept a coordinated Nash proposal only when immutable-baseline paper welfare strictly improves and the complete-assignment Jiagu sequential score is nonworse; otherwise dispatch the exact initializer.

training_gate.per_scenario_rule: The E713-E715 arithmetic mean must be strictly greater than the frozen V87 maximum advanced-baseline mean for all three metrics; ties and nonfinite values fail.
training_gate.joint_rule: All four scenarios must pass before a separate V89 confirmation plan may be written.
training_gate.failure_action: Retain the complete training cohort, do not consume E716-E718, and report that this bounded mechanism failed.
training_gate.success_action: Freeze code and binary without further tuning, preregister exactly E716-E718, then use a result-blind audit and one-time reveal for paper-group closure.
